items.title: R11 (`check_resource_generic_instantiations`) re-scans the WHOLE program and mints a TypeId per place for every resource instantiation: kolt's client has 27 instances × ~53k mints = 1.45M scratch type slots (570 ms, +109 MB; 10.6 ms on v0.41.1)

items.body: Since `Flow`/`Pipe` are `[resource]` traits, every std reactive generic called with a pipe is an R11 instance. Fix: scan only the instance's own body (`r11_body_calls_and_closures` already returns `body_exprs`) in `collect_instantiation_bindings`, `collect_instantiation_value_places`, `collect_is_refinements`, and read `place_value_type_id` rather than `get_type_id`. Expected −550 ms, −110 MB, and 1.45M fewer roots for M95. Sizing S.
